question: Which of the following acids is found in spinach?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxalic acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Oxalic acid i**s a crystalline substance that dissolves in water to create a** colorless solution**. Food items such as **spinach and cabbage,** **broccoli, parsley, and tomatoes contain it.**
 
• Oxalic acid is extensively used as an acid rinse <
